newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: OMV adds another 2.93 pct on index talk.
newsitem.headline: OMV adds another 2.93 pct on index talk.

text.p: Shares in oil and chemicals firm OMV climbed 2.93 percent in Vienna on Wednesday, extending a rally begun last Friday, as investors put money on the stock entering a European index.
At 0918 GMT, OMV was 45 schillings up at 1,580. Shares in Austria's biggest industrial group have risen more than 11 percent in the last three trading days.
"It looks like a safe bet that OMV will be in the new FTSE Eurotop 300 index," a market participant said.

The index, which is due to start in July, is being developed by FTSE International and the Amsterdam stock exchange. It will include the Vienna stock exchange with a 0.1 percent weighting, according to press reports.
International analysts said OMV shares had been ripe for an upward correction and traced recent strength to healthy international demand.
"For a long time OMV was the cheapest oil stock in Europe wit the highest compund earnings growth to the year 2000," one analyst said. -- Janet McBride, Vienna newsroom, +43-1 531 12 254
